mechanism: Albuterol activates beta-2 adrenergic receptors, driving potassium intracellularly and lowering serum potassium levels, which may cause dangerous hypokalemia especially in patients with baseline potassium depletion or concurrent diuretic use.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly in patients using albuterol, particularly with frequent or high-dose use; consider supplemental potassium or potassium-sparing agents if hypokalemia develops; assess for cardiac arrhythmias.
